verses.1: Even then, my heart will be troubled and rise up from its place.
verses.2: Hear the sound of his voice, which is loud and clear. It comes from his mouth.
verses.3: Under all the heavens, it will be raised up, and its light will shine upon the wings of the earth.
verses.4: After that, a loud cry will be heard in a terrifying manner. And no one will be able to hear it, because it will be too loud.
verses.5: He will thunder with his voice, doing great things and miracles. We do not know what will happen next.
verses.6: For the snow shall say, “This is land,” and the rain shall say, “This is dew.”
verses.7: In the hands of every person, it is possible to know everything that others have done.
verses.8: And Chayya will enter through Mo’Arev, and in its surroundings she will rest.
verses.9: From the gate, a cold wind blows; from the directions of the sun, it’s cold.
verses.10: From the spirit of El, Karah and vast seas are given in Muksak.
verses.11: Even if he tries to spread his light across the clouds, it will still be ineffective.
verses.12: And it will be transformed in its actions, according to all that is commanded before the sea of the land.
verses.13: If it’s in heaven, if it’s on earth, if it’s through divine grace, then it will be found.
verses.14: Eioob stood there, listening, and trembling.
verses.15: May the light of God shine upon them, and may the light of the clouds appear over them.
verses.16: Be aware of those who come from the land of Ab, from innocent people.
verses.17: In your midst, there is heat in the silence of the land from Dorom.
verses.18: He will go with them to play with strong players, just like Muzak.
verses.19: It was told us what should not be done in front of him.
verses.20: It is said that if a man speaks, then he will be punished.
verses.21: And now, they saw no light at all. It was in the darkness; a wind blew through them, and they became clean.
verses.22: From gold will be made this glorious statue of the divine Lord.
verses.23: He did not find any strength, justice, or righteousness in him.
verses.24: Therefore, people will fear him; none of the wise men will be able to fear him.
